title: Weekly bonuses
wikitext:
The current [[weekly bonuses]] announcements from the [[login screen]] and [[Foreman the Crier]]'s dialogue and quotes. A [[Player versus Environment|PvE]] and [[Player versus Player|PvP]] weekly bonus occur at the same time. Weekly bonuses change on Mondays at 15:00 [[w:Greenwich Mean Time|GMT]]/[[w:Coordinated Universal Time|UTC]] ({{North American daylight saving time|8:00 AM [[w:Pacific Time Zone|Pacific Daylight Time]]|7:00 AM [[w:Pacific Time Zone|Pacific Standard Time]]}}).

== Notes ==
* During [[Wayfarer's Reverie]], the following weekly bonuses are also active ([https://www.guildwars.com/en/events/wayfarer source]):
** Elonian Support Bonus
** Extra Luck Bonus
** Faction Support Bonus
** Northern Support Bonus
{{ bug|Despite the [[Weekly bonuses/Archive#Elonian Support Bonus|login screen announcements]] of Elonian Support and Northern Support Bonus stating that points are doubled ''"excluding completed [[Storybook|books]]"'', turning in completed books during the corresponding bonus will sometimes award double points.}}
{{ anomaly| Though the Pantheon Bonus [[Weekly bonuses/Archive#Pantheon Bonus|login screen announcement]] states all passage is free, accessing the Underworld from the [[Temple of Grenth]] in [[Lornar's Pass]] still costs {{cost|1000}}.}}

== Trivia ==
* Weekly bonuses replaced [[weekend events]] in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20130516|May 16, 2013 update]].
* Unlike weekend events, weekly bonuses occur at the same time as [[special event]]s.
